name: chapter4_tau_min_hardware_timing
description: Hardware and memory-interface timing assumptions used to justify tau_min for the Chapter 4 scrub controller.

scenarios.description: Controller-core service model: one protected SEC-DED codeword per 100 MHz scrub clock.
System-level memory-interface-limited model from Chapter 3: sustained 256 Mbit/s scrub service bandwidth shared with system overhead.

notes: The controller-core model checks that the RTL core is not the bottleneck.
The memory-interface-limited model is the binding Chapter 3 assumption for selecting tau_min = 1 s.
If the sustained memory service bandwidth changes, the primary scenario must be updated.
